text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The "Holy Hoof Festival" is a big autumn 
event 
where we get all hyped up together with 
everyone who cheers us on!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival, it's more cultural~ and... 
Ah! It might be closer to what you'd call 
a "school cultural festival"!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano & Her Friends
text_block_list.text:
“—Student Council Newsletter: Announcement 
of the Holy Hoof Festival Slogan”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
“This year's slogan is 'Cheering 
Together'”... Ooh~! 
It's finally starting, the Holy Hoof 
Festival!! What should we do?! What are we 
gonna do?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The upperclassmen said they're doing a 
band! Live music gets everyone pumped up, 
and it's easy to sing cheer songs to! It's 
totally perfect for the slogan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A band?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! Playing guitar, holding a bass, 
smashing drums! 
And bathing in all those stage lights! 
Don't you think something like that is—!

text_block_list.name: Mayano & Her Friends
text_block_list.text: Super duper coooool~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Strum-strum-strum-strum, *claaaaang*!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo! 
So cool! Maya-chan!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hey, class is starting! 
Mayano Top Gun-san, please take your seat!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Teach! Maya is aaaabsolutely gonna do a 
super cool band at the Holy Hoof Festival! 
We're gonna make all the fans scream and 
cheer!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
That's a nice goal, but make sure you 
properly deliver your cheers to the fans 
and to the Umamusume giving it their all, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey, Maya-chan! ...Are you 
seriously gonna form a band?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally serious! Come on, 
remember that movie we watched together 
the other day? 
The main guy in that band was suuuper 
cool, right?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I know! The main character was insanely 
gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right? With that shiny black hair 
fluttering around! Maybe Maya should dye 
her hair too?!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hey now! ...Everyone, please?

text_block_list.name: Mayano & Her Friends
text_block_list.text: ...Yeees.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-neesan! Is that a guitar?! 
Are you, like, gonna do a band or 
something?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Just me and Brian. 
We're about to practice right now.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, a band with the two of you... I 
wanna see it, I wanna see it so bad!! 
I'm totally getting front-row seats!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! When the time comes, we'll fire 
up your heart!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oho... Is that so...♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo~☆ 
Brian-san♪ Hishi Ama-san♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
............Hey, Ama-san. 
Something just snuck in.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't call me 'something'~~~!! 
Maya came here with some super important 
business for the two of you!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let Maya join this band too!! 
If you do, it'll be definitely, totally, 
the absolute coolest, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Listen up. This is our "Rock 'n' Roll"...!

text_block_list.name: Cool Band Fan
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaah!! Cool of the coooolest~!! 
It's so awesome my heart's going 
doki-doki...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nhehehe...♪ 
So, so, that's why! Maya wants to—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay! Maya wants to do it too! Right, 
Hishi Ama-san? 
If you're doing a band, you want at least 
one more person, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Like, for example, the genius Maya-chin 
who can do anything, or something... 
................Is that a no?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry about that. Our band has already 
submitted our stage application."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I think about it... there was 
another group looking for members. 
I can introduce you if you'd like! You 
know, that mature vibe you love—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—A band with mature Umamusume, huh...? 
Well, if I must~♡ 
When it comes to mature and cool, Maya's 
the perfect fit after all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I even bought the exact same bass 
as the movie's main character! 
Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem*♪ 
Pardon meee—...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Shake it baby!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?
